title: 111 and 222 synchronicities during the reunion trip

tellings.quote: He landed at 111. And Omar, who's coming from Yes Theory, he is taking off at 111.

plain: In 2026 the podcast host Jesse Michels went on a trip to bring together Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens about fifty years earlier. Michels says he kept seeing repeating numbers along the way, like 111 and 222. One example he gives: one person landed at 1:11 just as Omar, a guest coming from a group called Yes Theory, was taking off at 1:11. He tells this as a meaningful coincidence, a sign the trip was somehow meant to be.
